verdict.rationale: Docusign does expose versioned REST APIs (e.g. v2 eSignature API, OpenAPI/Swagger specs on GitHub) that could support a deprecation policy story, but no documented deprecation/versioning policy page is present, and a hands-on account describes being forced onto a 'legacy API version with no promise against sunsetting' after a security fix, directly contradicting reliable API lifecycle guarantees. missing for 10: an explicit deprecation-policy document, versioning changelog, and independent confirmation that old API versions are sunset predictably.
